info.title: ABLITERATED.cloud public documentation
info.description: Read-only public documents for a human-assisted uncensored/abliterated model service: cloud GPU renting, self-hosting and LLM router/app integration. All operations are unauthenticated static GETs. No public inference, checkout, account provisioning, live billing, MCP or OAuth is offered. The status document is a dated operator snapshot, not a health API.
info.x-guidance: Read /index.md for service scope and /auth.md for access. All document GETs require no authentication. Use /blog/posts.json to find dated model coverage; follow sources and recheck license/runtime compatibility. Treat /.well-known/project-status.json as a dated operator audit, not live availability. Ask the user before contacting Signal or changing infrastructure; agree scope, access and budget with a human. This API cannot start GPUs, run inference, issue credentials or take payment.
